title: Stacked area
description: Bands stacked from the baseline as eased monotone areas, coloured by position from the categorical tokens, with a 2px surface gap carved between them. Muted points are drawn out of bounds; the colour starts at the first live point. Each point owns its half steps for hover, with a wash over the plot and a pill behind its label.

anatomy.description: The root with data-slot="stacked-area", role="img" and the per-point totals as its summary; measures its width and draws the plot, with SPAN extra height when a span bracket is asked for.
A group per band with --fill set to var(--juni-categorical-<index>) and --band to its index: a muted path under a live one clipped to the selection.
A group per point: the invisible hit rect over its half steps, the hover wash, the label pill and the label; data-muted when out of bounds.

usage: bands are in stacking order from the baseline; the first takes categorical-0. Export AreaBand and AreaPoint are shared with AreaLine and StackedBars.
Mark points outside the selection muted rather than dropping them: the chart keeps the context's shape in the out-of-bounds hue.
Keep hover state in the caller: onHover reports the point's id or null, focus draws one point as the selection alone.
The legend is the caller's: Swatch and label per band, in band order, using the same categorical tokens.
